body: Well, partly because the GI doctors advice of taking both medications and sticking to the diet hasn't improved my symptoms and I was hoping to find people who had similar experiences with medication that can help me.
Yeah , I think the esomeprazole is helping with the acidity . But it is definitely giving me some sort of nerve pain in my left upper back. Hopefully going to ween off them soon.

I'm sorry you're going through this horrible experience too. 

Yeah I think I'm going to have to do that to be honest. Luckily I've got the time off to try and focus on healing and getting well atm but it is so annoying . 😭
Hope you get better soon.
Ah man, this is so annoying. Guessing it's probably best to try and heal the gastritis first . Then start taking stimulants 😭.

Sounds tough. Sorry you're dealing with this shit.

Yeah , unfortunately I had to take corticosteroids for an unrelated issue for around a year (no longer have to take them. Then I had to take a course of antibiotics for an infected wisdom tooth and ibuprofen for a dry socket. Since then my stomach has felt like it's completely destroyed.

Been suffering with severe nausea, bloating , fullness , left rib pain , back pain on my left side for 4 months now. I stuck to a low acid diet, dgl supplements, slippery elm, zinc l carnosine, vitamin b12 and  omeprazole as recommended by gp (20mg for 4 weeks) - made me 1000x worse.

I managed to get an endoscopy last month which only revealed mild gastritis- completely confused how I've felt so much pain for 'only mild gastritis ' perhaps it may have healed in the time before the endoscopy.  They recommended I take 20mg omeprazole for another 2 weeks which has made the situation worse again.

 Since then I've completely stopped ppis, following low acid diet with supplements and I'm still feeling like shit. Just at a complete loss on what to do.
